roaming_policy_document.title: Telecom Egypt (WE) - Global Roaming Tariffs & Passport Policy

operational_rules.rule: Postpaid consumer accounts require a minimum active tenure of 3 months or a 1,000 EGP refundable deposit to activate international roaming services. VIP Indigo Gold and Platinum tiers enjoy instant zero-deposit activation.

Pursuant to NTRA consumer protection mandates, data roaming without an active Roaming Passport bundle is hard-capped at 250 EGP per billing day unless the customer explicitly opts in via SMS to continue at pay-as-you-go rates.

Customers can subscribe before departure or upon arrival by dialing *202# or via My WE App. Roaming Passport bundles activate immediately upon first data usage or outgoing call in the covered destination.

bundle.name: Daily Travel Passport
bundle.supported_zones: Zone 1 (Arab Gulf & Middle East), Zone 2 (Europe & USA)
